title: Coffee house puts its menu on the Web - The Daily Packet

blocks.text: Coffee house puts its menu on the World Wide Web

content.text: The Chugging Coffee House on Elm Street has joined a small but growing list of local businesses with a page on the World Wide Web. Owner Dot says the idea came from a regular who kept bringing a laptop to the corner booth.
"People ask me what a home page is," she said. "I tell them it's like our sign out front, except you can read the menu from your living room."
Readers with a modem can visit the page at
, or find it through the Switchboard directory.
